title: Speech To Text with Amazon Transcribe [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on speech to text with Amazon Transcribe.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 Amazon Transcribe 語音轉文字實作。

cues.en: So here we go, our first step will be to go to the search bar and enter, you can just enter "transcribe".
cues.zh: 第一步到搜尋列，只需輸入 transcribe。

cues.en: Then you will find among the services here "Amazon Transcribe", powerful speech recognition indeed.
cues.zh: 服務裡會找到 Amazon Transcribe，強大語音辨識。

cues.en: Let's click on it and again, this will be a short and sweet demo.
I will just say something in English and we will see how it creates transcription into text, ok?
cues.zh: 我說一些英文，看看如何轉錄成文字。

cues.en: So here we go, "Amazon Transcribe Automatic Speech Recognition Creates a Transcript".
cues.zh: Amazon Transcribe，自動語音辨識，建立逐字稿。

cues.en: Ok, there we go, I just have to click this button and say something and so, well, I'm just gonna say the classic signature that we have.
cues.zh: 只要按鈕再說話，就說我們慣用的招牌句。

cues.en: Here we go, three, two, one, go.
Start streaming, top.
Hello my friends and enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 「朋友們好，享受雲端的樂趣吧。」

cues.en: Yes, done it.
And I can now stop streaming.
And you see, it continues to say what I was just saying.
cues.zh: 看，它還在轉錄我剛才說的。

cues.en: And yes, done it.
And I can now stop streaming.
Yep.
Ok, perfect.
So you see how it works.
You can also change the language settings and of course here you can change the language.
cues.zh: 也可修改語言設定，在這裡換語言。

cues.en: If you want, just for fun, we can try something in Spanish, I know we have a lot of Spanish students here.
cues.zh: 有很多西班牙語學生，有趣起見試西班牙語。

cues.en: So I'm gonna try Spanish from Spain, ok?
Let's go back up and I'm gonna say the same thing in Spanish.
cues.zh: 回上面，用西班牙語說同樣句子。

cues.en: Alright, here we go, three, two, one, start streaming.
Start a new stream, yes.
Start a new stream.
Start a new stream, here we go, three, two, one, go.
cues.zh: 開始新串流，三、二、一，開始。

cues.en: (speaks in foreign language) Or (speaks in foreign language) Sorry, I don't know which one was correct,
cues.zh: （以西班牙語說話）或者（以西班牙語說話）。抱歉，不知道哪個正確，

cues.en: but ah, see, it also continues in English.
Let's stop streaming.
Yes, I guess this one was correct, (speaks in foreign language) Sorry, my Spanish is not perfect, but I think I got the first sentence right.
cues.zh: 我猜這個正確，（以西班牙語說話）。抱歉，西班牙語不完美，但第一句應該對。

cues.en: And finally, because we also have a lot of members from India, well, I'm gonna say something in Hindi.
cues.zh: 最後也有很多印度學員，說點印地語。

cues.en: Here we go, language, and Hindi, perfect, this one, Hindi.
And are you ready for this?
Three, two, one, start streaming.
(speaks in foreign language)
All right, I have no idea if it provided the transcription the right way, but now it's supposedly doing it in English, I'm gonna stop streaming.
cues.zh: 不知道轉錄對不對，現在應該又在處理英文，我停止串流。

cues.en: Let me know in the comments if the first three sentences that I said are correct, 'cause I unfortunately don't know how to read this, sorry about that.
cues.zh: 留言告訴我前三句是否正確，可惜我讀不懂這些文字，抱歉。

cues.en: But there we go, let me know.
That's it for this hands-on tutorial on Amazon Transcribe.
cues.zh: 這就是 Amazon Transcribe 實作。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial, and until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂見，在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
